claims: NCIS was renewed for its 23rd season.
NCIS has been renewed for a 24th season in 2026.
Wikipedia notes that NCIS was renewed for Season 23 in February 2025.
Wikipedia notes that NCIS was renewed for Season 24 in January 2026.
NCIS features in-universe storylines about budget cuts and shutdowns.
Alden Parker (Gary Cole) leads the NCIS team, as shown in TV Fanatic's review.
